camera.unity: orthographic, no tilt, orthographicSize = max(7.5, 13.2/aspect) -> 15 world units tall on 16:9 (72 px/unit at 1080p, 48 at 720p)
camera.floorProjection: ground ellipses are drawn with y = 0.62 * radius (telegraphs, zones, rings, shadows) -> floor plane seen at ~38 deg elevation (asin 0.62)
camera.unitView: billboard sprites, 3/4 front view at the same ~38 deg elevation, body turned ~25 deg toward screen-right; the game mirrors with localScale.x for left-facing
camera.keyLight: one key light from upper-left-front (screen top-left), warm-neutral; crystal is the brightest emissive; rim light cool cyan from behind
